Unlock Conditions: Discover Acropolis of Atlantis; after that, clear 10 floors of the Labyrinth or Temple of Poseidon Endless Dungeons by defeating NPCs in battle or by solving all the puzzle torches on a given floor.

How to activate: Use Crystal of Blessing and select this blessing.

Effect: For 60 minutes, cannon penetration/reloading speed will be increased vs. NPC foes, including Phantom Monsters and Grande Ganadors. The effect is related to its current rank.
